title: Character state
description: A character's narrative state with versioned history (principle 3: state is versioned with as_of_chapter).

id.description: Stable identifier; lowercase kebab-case. Used as filename stem.

aliases.description: Other names/titles the character is known by.

current.description: State as of the latest written chapter.

history.description: Append-only list of per-chapter snapshots. history[i].as_of_chapter is strictly increasing.

as_of_chapter.description: The chapter number after which this snapshot was taken.

commit.description: State-snapshot linkage identifier shared with the producing chapter's state_after. This may be a content/tree hash or staging ID; it is not a self-referential containing-commit hash.

snapshot.description: A point-in-time view of a character.

location.description: Where the character physically is at this point.

knowledge.description: Key facts this character knows as of this chapter. Drives recall correctness — a secret not in knowledge must not be spoken.

relationships.description: Map of other character id → relationship descriptor.

status.description: Life status — alive, injured, missing, dead, etc.

notes.description: Free-form author notes not covered above.
